name: DeepWiki
description: AI code intelligence for any local codebase: a tree-sitter symbol/call graph (17 ngôn ngữ) (explore, callers/callees, blast-radius impact, snippets) plus an AI-generated, source-grounded wiki with conversational Q&A. One index powers both. Live re-indexing on file changes.

mcp.name: deepwiki-mcp
mcp.description: DeepWiki MCP: index a repo, explore its symbol/call graph (explore, symbol, impact, file_outline, snippet, list_files), pull source-grounded context, and generate/read browsable wiki pages

personas.name: wiki-author
personas.description: Generates a source-grounded wiki for a codebase

personas.name: codebase-guide
personas.description: Answers questions about a codebase, grounded in real source

personas.name: code-explorer
personas.description: Navigates and explains a codebase via the call graph
